Analysis for PraBat instrument

# Package loading

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggthemes)
library(tidybayes)
library(brms)
library(rstan)
library(loo)
library(coda)
library(ggridges)
library(lavaan)
library(ggbreak)
library(grid)
library(cowplot)
library(posterior)
library(mirt)
library(ggmirt)
library("validateR")
library(ppcor)
library(patchwork)
library(dplyr)
library(geomtextpath)
library(tidyboot)

# Defining functions we will need later

# Estimating mode function
estimate_mode <- function(s) {
  d <- density(s)
  return(d$x[which.max(d$y)])
}

# Highest Posterior Density interval
hdi_upper<- function(s){
  m <- HPDinterval(mcmc(s))
  return(m["var1","upper"])
}

hdi_lower<- function(s){
  m <- HPDinterval(mcmc(s))
  return(m["var1","lower"])
}

# distance from 1 (absolute value)
func <- function(x){
  abs(1-x)
}

# Function to extract model global fit indices later

get_m2_fit <- purrr::possibly(function(mod){
  out <- M2(mod)  # returns a list-like object
  tibble(
    M2      = unname(out$M2),
    df      = unname(out$df),
    p       = unname(out$p),
    RMSEA   = unname(out$RMSEA),
    RMSEA_L = unname(out$RMSEA.CI[1]),
    RMSEA_U = unname(out$RMSEA.CI[2]),
    SRMSR   = unname(out$SRMSR),
    TLI     = unname(out$TLI),
    CFI     = unname(out$CFI)
  )
}, otherwise = tibble(
  M2 = NA_real_, df = NA_real_, p = NA_real_,
  RMSEA = NA_real_, RMSEA_L = NA_real_, RMSEA_U = NA_real_,
  SRMSR = NA_real_, TLI = NA_real_, CFI = NA_real_
))


```

### Accuracy - Kenyan pilot

```{r}
data_kenya <- read_csv("../data/data_kenya.csv")%>%
  filter(Item %in% final_item_set) %>%
  mutate(age_group = factor(substr(Age, 1,1))) %>%
  mutate(
    lang = coalesce(
      if_else(lang == "K", "Kikuyu", NA_character_),
      if_else(lang == "S", "Kiswahili", NA_character_)))

data_kenya <- data_kenya %>%
  rename(age = Age) %>%
  mutate(age_z = (age - mean(age)/sd(age)))

```

#### Kikuyu

```{r}
data_kik <- data_kenya %>%
  filter(lang == "Kikuyu")
```

#### Combined plot Kikuyu and Kiswahili

```{r}
# Necessary dataframes for Kikuyu

age_mean_kik <- mean(data_kik$age)

accuracy_by_child_kik <- data_kik %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  summarise(
    proportion_correct = mean(correct, na.rm = TRUE),
    age   = first(age),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

binned_kik <- data_kik %>%
  mutate(
    bin_year = floor(age),
    bin_mid  = bin_year + 0.5,
    bin_mid_c = bin_mid - age_mean_kik
  ) %>%
  filter(!bin_year %in% c(2, 8)) %>%
  group_by(bin_year, bin_mid, bin_mid_c) %>%
  tidyboot_mean(
    column = correct,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

ndata_kik <- data_kik %>%
  distinct(age_z, .keep_all = TRUE)

post_kik <- fitted(model_pilot_kik, newdata = ndata_kik, re_formula = NA) %>% 
  as_tibble() %>%
  bind_cols(ndata_kik)

```

```{r}
# Combining two datasets

  mutate(binned_kik,  group = "Kikuyu")

  scale_x_continuous(breaks = year_breaks, labels = year_breaks) +
```

# Item selection procedure

### Step 1: IRT modeling for parameters and fit indices extraction

```{r}
# Plotting Infit and Outfit
rasch_fit_mode %>%
  ggplot(aes(task, mode)) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    ymin = 0.5, ymax = 1.5, # broader range (infit and outfit bigger or smaller than 0.5 and 1.5)
    xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf,
    fill = "grey90", alpha = 0.3
  ) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    ymin = 0.7, ymax = 1.3, # standard minimum acceptable range for infit and outfit (0.7 and 1.3)
    xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf,
    fill = "grey80", alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(color = mode < 0.7 | mode > 1.3), size = 2) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lci, ymax = uci), width = 0.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "solid") +
  facet_wrap(~fit_index) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("black", "red"), guide = "none") + # red if out of range
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.5, 0.7, 1, 1.3, 1.5, 2)) +
  labs(
    y = "Infit / Outfit Mean Square",
    x = "Item"
  ) +
  theme_few() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7),  # Changes y-axis tick label font size
  )

ggsave("../figures/rasch_infit_outfit.png", width = 8, height = 6)
```

```{r}
# Infit and Outfit means

absolute_fit_table <- rasch_fit_mode %>%
  group_by(fit_index) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(mode),
    sd   = sd(mode),
    min  = min(mode),
    max  = max(mode),
    pct_acceptable = mean(mode >= 0.7 & mode <= 1.3) * 100, # percentage of items that fit our model well enough
    .groups = "drop"
  )

absolute_fit_table

```

## Step 2: Simulated Annealing

Run script `selected_model_comparison.R` to perform model comparison using objective function and simulated annealing.

```{r}
model_comparison <- readRDS("../saves/model_comparison_18to23.rds")

selected_items <- model_comparison %>%
  dplyr::select(k, run, model, items) %>%
  unnest(items)

# ELPD-LOO = Expected Log Predictive Density, estimated via Leave-One-Out cross-validation --> how well new data is predicted by the model

# It does this by:
# leaving out each observation one at a time,
# asking “how well would the model predict this left-out observation?”,
# and summing the log predictive probabilities across all observations.
# --> higher the better, log probabilities

```

```{r}
model_comparison <- model_comparison %>%
  mutate(ratio = abs(elpd_diff) / (2*se_diff))%>%
  mutate(ratio = ifelse( elpd_diff == 0,0,ratio))%>%
  filter(ratio != 0)%>%
  mutate(ratio = ifelse(model == "2PL", ratio*-1, ratio))%>%
  arrange(run, disc_penalty)

```

#### Global fit indices for a Rasch model for each subset

```{r}
sel_by_k <- model_comparison %>% # table with items for each subset
  dplyr::select(k, items) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(k) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  unnest(items) %>%
  rename(item = items) %>%
  distinct(k, item)

sel_by_k_wide <- sel_by_k %>%  # wide format
  group_by(k) %>%
  summarise(items = list(item), .groups = "drop")

# Fitting Rasch model with 0.33 guessing level for each subset to look at global fit indices

k_tbl <- sel_by_k_wide %>% # takes wide format
  mutate(
    frq_fit_dat = map(items, ~ irt_dat %>% # creating dataset for each subset
      filter(task %in% .x) %>% # filter out data from items that were not chosen
      distinct(subjID, task, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
      dplyr::select(subjID, task, score) %>%
      mutate(score = as.numeric(score)) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = task, values_from = score) %>% # wide format
      dplyr::select(-subjID)
    ),
    freq_mirt = map(frq_fit_dat, ~ mirt( # fitting model for each subset
      data      = .x,
      model     = 1,
      itemtype  = "Rasch",
      verbose   = TRUE,
      guess = 0.33,
      na.rm     = TRUE,
      technical = list(NCYCLES = 5000)
    ))
  )

fit_tbl <- k_tbl %>%
  mutate(fit = map(freq_mirt, get_m2_fit)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-frq_fit_dat, -freq_mirt) %>%
  unnest_wider(fit)
fit_tbl
```

# Test re-test reliability


```{r}
data_trr <- read.csv("../data/data_reliability.csv") # importing dataset

items_per_session <- data_trr %>% # counting how many critical items each child completed
  filter(
    !startsWith(task, "DCExp"),
    !startsWith(task, "Famil")
  ) %>%
  group_by(id, test_time) %>%
  summarise(
    n_items = n_distinct(task),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

same_items <- items_per_session %>% # scoring whether children completed the same amount of items
  filter(test_time %in% c("one", "two")) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = test_time,
    values_from = n_items,
    names_prefix = "n_items_"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    same_n_items = !is.na(n_items_one) &
                   !is.na(n_items_two) &
                   n_items_one == n_items_two
  )

test_completion <- data_trr %>% # scoring whether they completed both test point 1 and test point 2
  group_by(id) %>%
  summarise(
    did_one = "one" %in% test_time,
    did_two = "two" %in% test_time,
    did_both = did_one & did_two,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

data_trr <- data_trr %>% # adding information
    filter(
    !startsWith(task, "DCExp"), # taking off familiarization and exposure trials
    !startsWith(task, "Famil"),
    id != "1F6K67kS", # participant completed 18-item-version and 19-item-version in the two test points
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    items_per_session,
    by = c("id", "test_time")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    test_completion,
    by = "id"
  ) %>%
  left_join(same_items, by = "id") %>%
  dplyr::select(-did_one, -did_two)

age_summary_trr <- data_trr %>%
  summarise(
    mean_age = mean(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_age  = min(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_age  = max(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_age   = sd(age, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

age_summary_trr # demographic information

data_trr %>%
  filter(did_both) %>%
  distinct(id, task) %>%
  count(id) 

data_rel_prop <- data_trr %>%
  filter(did_both) %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  mutate(
    age = first(age[test_time == "one"])
  ) %>%
  group_by(id, age, test_time) %>%
  summarise(
    proportion_correct = mean(correct, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = test_time,
    values_from = proportion_correct
  )

```

## Correlation between proportion scores

```{r}
cor.test(data_rel_prop$one, data_rel_prop$two, method = "pearson", use = "complete.obs")

r_trr <- cor(data_rel_prop$one, data_rel_prop$two, method = "pearson", use = "complete.obs")
```

# Figure 3: DIF, test-retest reliability and validity

```{r}
points_trr <- data_rel_prop %>%
  distinct(id, two, one) %>%
  count(two, one, name = "n")

p_trr <- ggplot(
  data_rel_prop,
  aes(x = two,
      y = one)
  ) +
  geom_point(
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.1, height = 0.1),
    size = 1,
    alpha = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    se = TRUE,
    level = 0.95,
    color = "green4",
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Test Point 2",
    y = "Test Point 1"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)+
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 0.8,
    y = 0.4,
    label = paste0(
      "italic(r) == ", round(r_trr, 2),
      "*','~~italic(p) < .001"
    ),
    parse = TRUE,
    hjust = 0,
    size = 4
  )

p_trr

ggsave(
  "../figures/plot_trr.png",
  plot = p_trr,
  width = 12,
  height = 6
)


plot_combined <- plot_grid(plot_grid(pdif, p_trr, p_val, align = 'h', ncol = 3, labels = c("A","B","C")))

ggsave(
  "../figures/plot_combined.png",
  plot = plot_combined,
  width = 15,
  height = 5
)

```
